title: Japan Shinkansen map as gitGraph (fun)
caption: Fun twist, not course work: Shinkansen lines as gitGraph branches, stations as commits in geographic order. main = Tokaido trunk from Tokyo; branches diverge at their real junctions (Omiya/Takasaki area, Shin-Aomori, Shin-Osaka, Hakata). NEXT + REVERSE = not yet open (Hokkaido Sapporo extension, Chuo maglev). Conceptual map only, not to scale and not every station.

branches.label: main — Tokaido Shinkansen
branches.summary: Honshu trunk: Tokyo west along the Tokaido line to Shin-Osaka, where the Sanyo line continues.

nodes.title: Tokyo
nodes.detail: Capital hub: Tokaido, Tohoku, Joetsu and Hokuriku services all start here.

nodes.title: Nagoya
nodes.detail: Tokaido Nagoya; the future Chuo maglev will also terminate here (see chuo-maglev branch).

nodes.title: Shin-Osaka
nodes.detail: Junction: Sanyo Shinkansen continues west from here.

branches.label: tohoku — Tohoku Shinkansen
branches.summary: North from Tokyo via Omiya, Sendai and Morioka to Shin-Aomori; Joetsu and Hokuriku diverge at Omiya/Takasaki.

nodes.title: Omiya
nodes.detail: Junction station: Joetsu (via Takasaki to Niigata) and Hokuriku (via Takasaki/Nagano) services diverge in this area.

nodes.title: Shin-Aomori
nodes.detail: Northern Honshu terminus; Hokkaido Shinkansen continues through the Seikan Tunnel.

branches.label: joetsu — Joetsu Shinkansen
branches.summary: From Omiya/Takasaki across the mountains to Niigata on the Sea of Japan coast.

branches.label: hokuriku — Hokuriku Shinkansen
branches.summary: From the Omiya/Takasaki area via Nagano and Kanazawa to Tsuruga (opened to Tsuruga in 2024).

branches.label: hokkaido — Hokkaido Shinkansen
branches.summary: Through the Seikan Tunnel to Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto (open); Sapporo extension is under construction.

nodes.title: Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto
nodes.detail: Current northern terminus, gateway to Hakodate.

nodes.title: NEXT Sapporo
nodes.detail: Sapporo extension under construction, not yet open — marked NEXT / REVERSE.

branches.label: chuo-maglev — Chuo Shinkansen (maglev, future)
branches.summary: Future maglev: Shinagawa (Tokyo) to Nagoya, branching conceptually from Tokyo on main before the Tokaido run west.

nodes.title: NEXT Shinagawa (Chuo maglev)
nodes.detail: Planned Tokyo maglev terminus at Shinagawa; not yet open.

nodes.title: NEXT Nagoya (Chuo maglev)
nodes.detail: Planned first-phase maglev terminus at Nagoya; not yet open.

branches.label: sanyo — Sanyo Shinkansen
branches.summary: Continuation of the Tokaido line west from Shin-Osaka to Hakata (Fukuoka).

nodes.title: Hakata
nodes.detail: Sanyo terminus in Fukuoka; Kyushu Shinkansen continues south from here.

branches.label: kyushu — Kyushu Shinkansen
branches.summary: South from Hakata via Kumamoto to Kagoshima-Chuo.
